source: House of Commons Library 2024 constituency + candidate named CSVs, read from emagar/caso-pc-oto2024 GitHub third-party copies
A: Is raw margin-turnout relationship robust within UK regions/nations or a compositional artifact?

B.H1: OLS slope attenuation at least 30% after region fixed effects

C.execution: 650 ONS constituencies into 12 regions/4 nations; simple OLS turnout~margin and then +region fixed effects and +ENP, HC3. Country-specific Spearman without dropping NI, Scotland or Wales; counts and strata logged. No causal p values.

F: Regional adjustment attenuates magnitude ~33%, but negative effect remains within England and Wales, whereas NI and Scotland sign positive; NI n=18. Do not label strong causal/individual effects or interpret regions as randomized units.
G: Country subgroup 18/32/57, national politics differ, one election and boundary changes, no data on deprivation/class/education, no genuine external replicate.
J: Evaluate region/country held-out diagnostics against a simple trained-mean and margin-only baseline.
